episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Horace and Pete open the bar to their regulars. Family members come and go, and a secret is revealed that could affect the future of the bar. Sylvia's claim to her inherited part of Horace and Pete's brings the family together, as Horace has to deal with his own relationship to Rachel.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Sylvia drops a bomb. An old friend of Pete's unexpectedly appears at the bar. Marsha keeps Horace off balance.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Horace's ex-wife comes to the bar to ask for his advice.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Uncle Pete offers Pete advice about women. Horace connects with an old girlfriend.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The family gathers at the bar. Marsha reminisces about her teenage years. Horace makes a proposal to Sylvia.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Pete goes on a date. Later, he brings her home for a family dinner.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Pete wants to landmark the bar. Horace spends the night with a customer.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Horace takes Pete to see his doctor. Tricia visits Pete again.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Pete has a vision. Horace visits Tricia in the hospital.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: It's 1976 and we meet the family. Sylvia wants to travel. Pete returns.
